title: Templates for this module
body: Copy-ready structures you can reuse in your own engagements. Examples are fictional.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Milestone ID, outcome, owner, dependency, target date, acceptance evidence, customer agreement, status, escalation, next decision

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: Readiness → scoped validation → evidence review → executive decision → technical/commercial gates → onboarding/value review.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: Customer confirms commitments; dates are proposed until accepted.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Purpose, priorities, accepted/conditional/deferred decisions, assumptions to correct, action, owner, due, approved links, version

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: Thank you; we prioritized UC-01/02/03. Acceptance is conditional on access and baseline validation. Please correct assumptions and confirm owners/dates.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: Within 24 hours when specified; exclude restricted account judgments; no automatic sending.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Outcome/sponsor, priority IDs, maps, data/access, assumptions, metric cards, validation findings, scope/exclusions, MAP, open risks, receiving owner acceptance

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: Delivery receives maps/dependencies; CS/value owner receives baseline and reallocation/measurement plan.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: Receiving owner acknowledges; unresolved items remain visible rather than becoming commitments.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Phase, customer outcome, service, deliverables, acceptance, partner/Glean/customer RACI, dependency, exclusion, commercial review, metric

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: Readiness/content cleanup → scoped build → adoption → value review, only if justified by discovery.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: Not a signed SOW; commitments require appropriate scope and contract approval.
